async def act(page):
    # Fill in the title for the new issue
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)")
    await title_textbox.fill("Implement Dark Mode")
    
    # Fill in the description for the new issue
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")
    await description_textbox.fill("Discuss the implementation of dark mode for the solarized-prism-theme project. This should include considerations for UI components, color schemes, and user preferences.")
    
    # Click the 'Issue' button to submit the new issue
    issue_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Issue")
    await issue_button.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete after submission
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
